description: Dark theme. Allows users to enable and customize the system-wide dark theme, including options for forcing dark theme on unsupported apps and setting an automatic schedule. This screen is identical on device with: api_dark_ui_mode. Preconditions to accessing: Always enabled.

purpose: Whether the system dark theme is manually enabled

possibleValues: None (None), Turns on at custom time (Turns on at custom time), Turns on from sunset to sunrise (Turns on from sunset to sunrise)
purpose: The schedule for switching dark mode on and off.

description: Allows users to enable and customize the system-wide dark theme, including options for forcing dark theme on unsupported apps and setting an automatic schedule. This screen is identical on device with: dark_ui_mode. Preconditions to accessing: Battery Saver must be off or the device must allow Dark theme settings during Battery Saver.

hintText: Preconditions to accessing: Battery Saver must be off or the device must allow Dark theme settings during Battery Saver.

description: Allows users to choose their geographical region, which affects system-wide formatting for dates, times, temperatures, and other measurement systems.

hintText: [Must show to user]: The region is going to be changed, but the device will keep current language as a system language.
purpose: The geographical region used by the system to determine regional formatting for dates, times, and measurements.

description: Allows users to view, select, and manage Access Point Names (APNs) required for the device to connect to the carrier's data network. Preconditions to accessing: The subscription must have a GSM APN.

Sound & vibration. Allows users to manage device audio settings, including adjusting volume levels for various streams, selecting sound patterns for ringtones and notifications, and toggling specific system-wide sounds and vibration behaviors. This screen is identical on device with: api_sound_screen

hintText:
Preconditions to accessing: The device must support configuring media volume in Settings.
Preconditions to setting: This setting must not be restricted by a device administrator.
purpose: The system volume level for media playback. Higher is louder.

hintText:
Preconditions to accessing: The device must support configuring call volume in Settings and not be a single volume device.
Preconditions to setting: This setting must not be restricted by a device administrator.
purpose: The system volume level for phone calls. Higher is louder.

description: Allows users to toggle NFC for data exchange and contactless payments, select a default payment app, and manage security settings for contactless transactions.

hintText:
Preconditions to accessing: The device must have near field communication(NFC) capability.
This is permanently unavailable on this device due to: NFC is not available on this device.
Setting this preference is permanently unavailable on this device due to: NFC is not available on this device.
purpose: Enable or disable NFC (Near Field Communication)

hintText:
Preconditions to accessing: The device must support the require device unlock for NFC payments feature.
This is permanently unavailable on this device due to: Require device unlock for NFC payments is not supported on this device.
Setting this preference is permanently unavailable on this device due to: Require device unlock for NFC payments is not supported on this device.
purpose: Require device to be unlocked to use NFC

description: Wi‑Fi hotspot. Allows users to configure and manage the Wi-Fi hotspot settings for their device, including the network name, password, and security protocol. Preconditions to accessing: Data saver must be turned off and this setting must not be restricted by a device administrator.

hintText: Preconditions to accessing: Wifi hotspot must be enabled.
purpose: Whether the Wi-Fi hotspot is currently enabled

hintText: Preconditions to accessing: The device must support wifi hotspot.
purpose: The broadcast name (SSID) of the Wi-Fi hotspot
Whether the hotspot automatically turns off when no devices are connected
